title: If Your Phone Ever Charges To 101%... DO NOT UNPLUG IT

shots.line: You walk into your kitchen at three in the morning.
shots.scene: kitchen wide empty, clock runs backwards, window pure black

shots.line: Your phone is on the counter. Charging. But the battery... reads one hundred and one percent.
shots.scene: phone close-up: battery icon shows 101%, screen glows wrong colour

shots.line: If this ever happens to you... there is only one rule.
shots.scene: bigFace YOU: confused, then realisation dawning. Eyes tiny white dots.
WARNING TEXT: blood red ALL CAPS fills screen, glitch effect, phone silhouette behind

shots.line: Subject A unplugged theirs at oh four hundred hours. The screaming started twelve seconds later and hasn't stopped.
shots.scene: field report: navy void, SUBJECT figure faded, wrong, data overlay
shots.notes: WHAT HAPPENS IF YOU BREAK IT

shots.line: Step one. Remain calm. The thing in the phone feeds on your reaction. If you panic, it wins.
shots.scene: medium: YOU in kitchen, phone glowing on counter. Protocol step ONE appears in red

shots.line: Step two. Do not make eye contact with the screen. Even when it's off. Especially when it's off.
shots.scene: 3D orbit: empty kitchen, phone on counter glowing, camera slowly circles it

shots.line: The screen will show you a message from someone you love. It will look real. It will sound real. It is not.
shots.scene: phone close-up: screen flickers, shows distorted message, glitch frames, static burst
